text:
Address: http://127.0.0.1:40485/
Title: What a scan reads
Pointer: not yet over the page

You'd scan 17,244 files if you scanned right now. The page's first suggestion is about ignore files.

The page says it found 25 .gitignore files and 15 .tfignore files, in 3 top folders. It gives you two buttons: "Take them in" and "Ignore them". Taking them in would add their rules to your list, so those files would be left out. I haven't clicked either, so nothing has changed.

It also offers two starter lists for what to leave out:
- **What these folders hold:** 47 lines, which would leave out 6,291 files.
- **GitHub's Visual Studio list:** 234 lines, which would leave out 6,363 files.

You can also write your own lines in the box, in the same format as a .gitignore.
